notes: Built by hardware/mechanical/cad/src/part_sheets.py (python3 hardware/mechanical/cad/src/part_sheets.py; ~3 min). Never runs build_all.main(); only build_all.collect(). 125 sheets: 104 print files (stl/print 01-09 incl. 06 tools, 08 plywood jigs, 09 perfboard jigs) + 21 print_extra files (group EX) + 0 plywood pieces (group PLY). FIXES 2026-10-08 (review): (1) DXF layer HIDDEN now uses a real dashed linetype HIDDEN (defined in the file: dash 2.0 / gap 1.0 mm; ezdxf setup has no HIDDEN, it used to fall back to CONTINUOUS); plywood DRILL_BLIND too. (2) hole tags: holes on one axis line in the same view share ONE tag (e.g. 'H1/H3', 'H4~H8'), every tag/section letter is placed at the first free spot around its hole (8 corners/sides, inside big openings, then short leaders) and registered in the layout check; the sheet notes list the shared tags. (3) every edge coordinate the views found is kept: the sheet notes say how many were left off ('모서리 좌표 N개는 시트에서 생략 ...'), all of them are in _좌표.csv in each zip (axis, coord, edge length, on_sheet, world axis/value) and as ordinate DIMENSIONs on DXF layer DIM_MORE. (4) plywood shop rectangles printed with 2 decimals like D06 (139.65, 56.35, 14.14) in sheet, DXF text and readme. (5) zip readme had literal '\r\n' and the CSVs a literal '\ufeff' (escaping bug): now real CRLF and BOM; file names keep '-' (C#·D# -> Cs-Ds). (6) style.css: chips and main buttons min-height 44px under pointer:coarse. Card ids: partdwg- (P-01-01 .. P-09-02, P-EX-01..21, P-PLY-01..10). Other tabs map a print file to its code with fin/parts/index.json by_file (key = 'hardware/mechanical/cad/stl/print/...') or window.toccata.partdwg.codeOf(file); window.toccata.partdwg.open(code) opens the viewer. FIXES 2026-10-08 round 2 (review 'hole tables'): (a) the slice levels lost the TOP vertex interval of every part (float32 top face 44.849998 vs vertex plane rounded to 44.85 > ext) and capped the levels at 320: now one level in every interval (no cap below 2000), so blind holes that start at the top face are found -- P-05-17/18 Ø4.2 x 4.5 insert holes (world x506|716, y246/322, z61.35) and P-05-12/13 magnet pocket Ø8 teardrop x 3.2 at (5.75, 61) (world 265.75|956.25, 275) are in the tables; the '없음' claim is gone. (b) a fitted circle must match the ring's own box (circle inside the box, one side = Ø, both for 'round'): the P-03-01/02 lever bay (39.16x63.85, 45.6x63.85) and the P-06-03 pocket (40.4x19.4) are no longer 'Ø71/Ø75/Ø41 teardrop'; 'rect' only for true rectangles (area > 99.8 % of the box), others 'other' with box + bbox centre, and the outline at mid depth in the CSV. (c) engraved letters (any outline incl. 'O' rings and dots, <= 1.05 deep at the CAD depths 0.4/0.5/0.6/0.8, <= 8 x 8, one end open straight to the air, not stacked on a deeper void) get no hole number: P-02 note names, P-04 pad bar labels, P-06/08/09 tool and jig labels; the sheet note says '새김 글자 (깊이 ..) N곳' and the CSV lists them as '새김'. (d) cones/changing pieces run between vertex planes and their Ø is taken AT the end planes: P-05-19 / P-05-21 countersinks Ø4.5->Ø8.59, z1.957~4.0 (was Ø6.59, z1.985~3.008); straight ends snap to the vertex plane (1.957, not 1.985). (e) islands standing in a pocket are measured and part of the group key: P-05-16 H8 '사각 38x36 +섬' (island 20.4x18 at x37.1~57.5, y3.55~21.55) is split from its empty twin (the reviewer's '20.4x18 pocket' is that solid island, the opening itself is 38x36). (f) pattern notes print sizes to 0.01 (P-03-01 'H3 Ø1.95 x12', was 'Ø2 x11 · Ø1.9'). (g) the duplicate filter only drops a void seen along two axes when the boxes cover each other (> half of the bigger extent): the key hollows that used to vanish behind a small front pocket are listed. (h) pieces thinner than 0.25 and slivers of voids that open elsewhere are counted in a note ('짧은 경사 조각'), not numbered. PUBLISH: the page must declare capabilities {downloads: true} for the zip buttons (claude.use('downloads') -> save({filename:'*.zip', data: Blob})); without it the buttons show the file name/size and a note. 3D (2026-10-30, user: '부품 도면을 보는 곳에도 3D 모델링을 둬서 3D 프린팅을 어떤 단위로 하는 건지 볼 수 있게'): the viewer has three modes (도면 / 3D 출력 모양 = the STL on the 256 x 256 P1S bed as it prints; orange = the faces Bambu Studio's support touches (A13: only the key tails, tree support from the plate; check_support.py) / 3D 조립 자리 = the instrument with this file's instances in blue), every card has a 3D button, and the overview card '출력 단위 3D' paints the whole instrument by print file (hue per folder, lightness per file; group chips filter it; 벌려 보기 lifts the stacked prints). Data: fin/parts3d/g-.json + index.json from part_meshes.py (run by write_tab; ids printed in pieces, CU-PLY-BOTTOM / CU-PLY-BACK, are drawn from their piece STLs placed by body.lap_pieces), assembly = the 04 tab's cad/toccata.glb.b64.txt. python3 part_sheets.py --tab rebuilds only the fragment + meshes from fin/parts/index.json (seconds). Assets: 289 files in fin/parts (23.7 MB): per part .svg (sheet, lazy ) + .zip.b64.txt (STL exact bytes + DXF + SVG + hole CSV + readme), all_stl.zip.b64.txt (= hardware/mechanical/cad/Toccata_출력STL_전체.zip, matches stl/print: True), all_dxf.zip.b64.txt, index.json. CHECKS (independent, trimesh instead of manifold3d; drawings/parts/verify.json): 124/125 parts pass. bbox of the STL in drawing pose vs sheet size: 125 parts, max err 0.0004 mm; 3166 ordinate values each lie on a vertex plane of the STL (tol 0.011); 357 straight round holes re-measured by trimesh section + own circle fit (centre and Ø, tol max(0.02, 0.03 % of Ø)), max err 0.0206 mm; world placement: 70 parts drawing box mapped by W == CAD instance bbox (tol 0.02), 235 hole middles mapped to world are not inside the CAD instance; every zip holds the exact STL bytes (sha1), DXF parses with units mm and layers VISIBLE/HIDDEN/SECTION/DIM/DIM_MORE/TEXT; every SVG parses as XML. New checks: all 3826 edge coordinates (sheet + 660 left off the sheet, = coordinate CSV rows = DXF DIM_MORE dimension count per part) lie on STL vertex planes; DXF layer HIDDEN uses a linetype with gaps (no CONTINUOUS) on every file; independent text-box overlap over EVERY of every sheet SVG (not only the registered boxes; same font metric): 0 overlapping pairs in total, 0 involving hole tags, 0 sheets with any overlap; readme CRLF and CSV BOM checked in every zip. Round-2 checks (trimesh, independent of the finder's levels): 1100 straight holes/pockets of the tables re-measured on a section at mid depth, outline box max err 0.0096 mm, and every 'Ø' / 'teardrop' word checked against that box; completeness: 33086 closed inner loops of dense sections (every vertex plane +-0.3 inside the part + a 1 mm grid, x/y/z) -> 1 not inside a listed hole, engraving or fragment. Failures: {"P-02-14": ["1 inner loops of the dense sections not in the hole table / engravings / fragments"]}. Layout self-check (registered text boxes incl. hole tags and section letters, drawings.Sheet.check): 0 overlaps left over all sheets; tags with no free spot (forced): 0; dimensions / angle marks whose text would collide are skipped (their values stay in the notes); hole tables cut (rest in holes.csv/DXF): none. Limits: hole finder = closed inner rings of x/y/z slices (holes open to a side, e.g. the sideways M3 nut slot at the white-key tail, show in the views / sections, not in the table); 'other' outlines are given as box + centre on the sheet and as the full outline in the hole CSV; islands are measured at mid depth; engraved letters are counted in the notes, not numbered; lever carrier files contain the breakaway support (drawn, noted); 04 pad bars are the PORON 5T files (the assembly model is the 6T design, world coords via ICP on the common faces); tools/jigs have no world coords; plywood sheets reuse drawings.py D06 logic (flat_piece, piece_memo, ply_spots, ply_jigs).
